_doc: ROADMAP 7.1r: data cells that lie inside mog's CODE hunks and that C++ reads or writes (flag words, texts, small tables). tools/gen_data.py makes each one an own C++ object (g_cell_mog_<label>, initialised from the original binary, extent = up to the next label of the hunk) and aliases the original label to it; nothing is assembled any more, so the dead code around them is gone. Not part of the overlay-entry reset (they never were). link_names: a pointer cell in an owned hunk that held a code label the asm defined now holds the C++ routine that took its place. asm_labels: labels only the MS_SYNTH_ASM A/B hunk (asm/synth.s) defines: a pointer cell naming one is nullptr unless the generator runs with --asm-labels.
